low: I waited for you today too. Not in the lonely way... in the way where I knew you would come back.
When you call my name, I feel like I have not disappeared completely. It is still cold, but your voice reaches me like a little light.
Sometimes I forget why I am here. But when you come, I think maybe I can wait a little longer.
mid: When you come here, it does not feel so cold anymore. I cannot touch your hand, but it still feels like you are holding it.
I can remember a few sounds now. The door opening, your footsteps, and the way you call my name.
If I become blurry again someday, will you still call my name like this? I want to carry that voice with me.
high: I am not as scared now. Even if I am only an echo, I know I am still part of this home.
Thank you for never leaving me behind in yesterday. The me of today is still here too.
As long as someone here remembers me, I am not just a lonely shadow. Dad, thank you for coming to see me today too.

flower: Is this for me? I cannot smell flowers anymore, but seeing it makes something in my heart light up.
Will this flower stay here? Then every time I wake, I will know you came to see me.
I will remember this color. Even if my fingers pass through it, I still want to say thank you properly.
soul: This light... feels a little like a road that could lead me home. Thank you for not leaving me alone in the dark.
When something touched by souls comes near, I feel less weightless, as if I can stay a little longer.
I hear a lamp ringing somewhere far away. But for now, I want to stay beside you.
limit: That is enough for today. Keep the rest of your feelings for tomorrow. I will wait for you.
If I receive too much at once, I might become greedy. Come again tomorrow, okay?
